main_text.p: preced. Radice. Hiph. Infinit. לַצְבּוֹת Ad tumidum reddendum, Num.5.22. pro לְהַצְבּוֹת.

צָב m. Tumidum, Tumens: Metaphoricè Cameratum, Numer.7.3. Bufo, Testudo, quia ejus operimentum cameratum est, Levit.11.29. Plural. צְבִים Currus camerati, Jesa.66. v.20. Fœmininum, צְבָרָה Tumens, Num.5.22.

צָבִי m. Decus, Gloria, Ornamentum, sic dicta, quòd hac animum Tumidum reddant: לַעֲטֶרֶת צְבִי Pro corona decoris, Jes.28.1. וְאֶל־הַצֶּבִי Et versus decus ipsum, Dan.8.9. id est, Judæam, quæ hoc elogio aliquoties appellatur, ut Psal.48.3. Ezech.20.6. Dan.11.16. Et secundum aliam significationem, Caprea, Capreolus, Deut.12.22. & 14.5. 1.Reg.4.23. Plural. הַצְּבָיִם Caprearum, 2.Sam.2.18. & deficit in eo plurale: Et sic cum Epenthesi א וּכְצִבָאִים [?] Et sicut caprea, 1.Paral.12.8. Similis flexio in פְּתִי, de qua in פַּתָּה. Et Fœmin. צְבִיָּה Caprea, Cant.4.5. Plural. בִּצְבָאוֹת Cum capreis, Cant.2.7.
צְבַט Porrexit: Futurum, וַיִּצְבְּטֶ־לָהּ Et porrexit ei, Ruth.2.14. Targum, וְאוֹשִׁיט.

צְבַע Pinxit, Tinxit, Coloravit: Chaldæis usitatius est: Partic. Pahul, הָעִיט צָבוּעַ Avis colorata, Jerem.12.9. id est, fœdata sanguine, juxta R.Salomonem: vel, Digitata, hoc est, rapax, uncis unguibus in prædam involans, ex significatione Nominis אֶצְבַּע quod sequitur. Chald. Particip. Pahel, מִצְבְּעִין Tingunt, Intingunt, Daniel.4. v.22. Ithpeh. יִצְטַבַּע Tingatur, Dan.4.12.
m. צָבַע m. Color, Tinctura: Versicolor, Coloratum: Plural. שְׁלַל צְבָעִים Præda versicolorum, Jud.5.30.
אֶצְבַּע f. Digitus, à Pingendo: Aff. אֶת־אֶצְבָּעוֹ Digitum suum, Levit.4. v.6. Plural. אֶצְבָּעוֹת Digiti, Jerem.52.21.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some letters in the Hebrew forms (notably the Epenthesis form in Caprea and the Pahel/Ithpeh forms) are hard to read at this scan resolution; they are copied as best seen, with [?] where doubtful. Large Hebrew lemmas in the left margin (צבט, צבע) are headwords printed in the margin and are given as notes. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. Jes., Jesa.). The catchword "Constr." sits at the bottom right below the last line.
